preamble.summary: Deuteronomy 31 narrates Moses' commissioning of Joshua and introduces the Song of Moses. 4QDeutᵇ preserves vv. 9–11 (the seven-yearly Torah reading at Sukkot) and 24–32:3 (the song's introduction and opening).
preamble.notable_variants: No significant content variants. The 'be strong and courageous' commissioning (v. 6, 7, 23) tracks MT.
preamble.scroll_condition: 4QDeutᵇ provides moderate coverage of vv. 9-11 and the chapter's closing transition into the Song.

variant_notes: 'Be strong and of good courage' tracks MT. Cited at Heb 13:5 (loosely).
'Take this Book of the Law and put it by the side of the ark of the covenant' tracks MT.
